sentences.zh: 但老实说，他们看起来状态太差了，以至于我想即使我介入了，我也不确定能怎么帮上忙。

sentences.en: I felt like I should step in.
sentences.zh: 人们发现他们简直就像冻住了一样。

sentences.en: But to be honest, they looked so out of it that I thought even if I did step in, I wasn't sure how I could help.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛完全是白色的。

sentences.en: People found them literally almost seemingly frozen.
sentences.zh: 它们睁得很大，但只有白色，而且口吐白沫。

sentences.en: Her eyes were just completely white.
sentences.zh: 然后那个男人变得僵硬。

sentences.en: They were wide open, but just white and frothing at the mouth.
sentences.zh: 他的手臂停止了移动。

sentences.en: And then the man went stiff.
sentences.zh: 那天在公园长椅上，他们基本上已经陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: His arms stopped moving.
sentences.zh: 那么英国当局表示他们被发现时这种状况的原因是什么？

sentences.en: And they were basically already in a coma there on that park bench that day.
sentences.zh: 首相已证实，前俄罗斯间谍谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔及其女儿是被一种由俄罗斯开发的军用级神经毒剂毒害的。

sentences.en: And what have the authorities in Britain said was the cause of this condition they were found in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，英国人进行了测试，他们将其锁定为一种名为“诺维乔克”的神经毒剂。

sentences.en: The prime minister has confirmed that the former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter were poisoned by a military grade nerve agent of a type developed by Russia.
sentences.zh: 首相已证实，前俄罗斯间谍谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔及其女儿是被一种由俄罗斯研发的军用级神经毒剂所毒害。

sentences.en: Well, the British have done tests and they have narrowed it down to a nerve agent called Novichok.
sentences.zh: 嗯，英国方面已经进行了检测，并将范围缩小到了一种名为“诺维乔克”的神经毒剂。

sentences.en: Novichok is the name for a family of nerve agents said to be the most deadly ever created.
sentences.zh: “诺维乔克”是一种神经毒剂的名称，据称是迄今为止制造出的最致命的毒剂。

sentences.en: It was developed by the
sentences.zh: 它是由

sentences.en: Soviet Union in the 1970s and 80s.
sentences.zh: 苏联在20世纪70年代和80年代研发的。

sentences.en: When inhaled or absorbed into the skin, it causes suffocation and heart failure.
sentences.zh: 一旦吸入或经皮肤吸收，会导致窒息和心脏衰竭。

sentences.en: The Russians deny it.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯方面对此予以否认。

sentences.en: They say they destroyed all of their declared chemical weapons last year.
sentences.zh: 他们声称去年已经销毁了所有申报的化学武器。

sentences.en: But one of the chemical weapons they didn't declare was Novichok.
sentences.zh: 但他们未申报的化学武器中就包括“诺维乔克”。

sentences.en: And they now deny that they even ever created it.
sentences.zh: 而且他们现在甚至否认曾经制造过这种毒剂。

sentences.en: Have you seen the photos of the Skripal in the hospital?
sentences.zh: 你看到斯克里帕尔在医院的照片了吗？

sentences.en: Have you seen this?
sentences.zh: 你看到这个了吗？

sentences.en: You're saying that...
sentences.zh: 你是说……

sentences.en: No, no, I'm juSt...
sentences.zh: 不，不，我只是……

sentences.en: I didn't see this.
sentences.zh: 我没看到这个。

sentences.en: You doubt?
sentences.zh: 你在怀疑？

sentences.en: You doubt that he is...
sentences.zh: 你在怀疑他是否……

sentences.en: But did you see them?
sentences.zh: 但你看到他们了吗？

sentences.en: You doubt that he is still as...
sentences.zh: 你在怀疑他是否依然……

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: No proofs.
sentences.zh: 没有证据。

sentences.en: And Peter, this might be a difficult question for anyone, let alone a Westerner, to answer, but how would
sentences.zh: 彼得，这对任何人来说可能都是个难题，更不用说西方人了，但这两个人

sentences.en: these two people come to have somehow ingested or been exposed to a nerve agent?
sentences.zh: 是如何摄入或接触到神经毒剂的呢？

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: I think in this case, there's a question about whether it might have been inhaled or come through the skin, whether it was aerosolized, if you will, made into an aerosol spray.
sentences.zh: 我认为在这种情况下，问题在于它是通过吸入还是皮肤接触进入体内的，或者说，它是否被雾化了，也就是制成了气溶胶喷雾。

sentences.en: Up to 500 people in Salisbury who went to the same pub and restaurant as a poisoned Russian spy,
sentences.zh: 索尔兹伯里有多达500人曾去过中毒的俄罗斯间谍、

sentences.en: former spy, and his daughter are being advised to wash their clothes and clean any possessions they handled whilst they were there.
sentences.zh: 前间谍及其女儿去过的同一家酒吧和餐厅，这些人被建议清洗衣物并清理他们在那里接触过的任何物品。

sentences.en: The table used by the Skripals was so contaminated, it had to be destroyed.
sentences.zh: 斯克里帕尔父女使用的桌子污染严重，不得不被销毁。

sentences.en: This is a weapon that didn't just endanger the one person they really apparently wanted to kill,
sentences.zh: 这种武器不仅危及了他们真正想要杀害的那个人，

sentences.en: Sergei Skripal.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔。

sentences.en: It put in danger dozens, potentially hundreds of people who might have come into
sentences.zh: 它还危及了数十甚至数百名可能与

sentences.en: contact with him or his daughter, or just even the very area that they were found in on the park bench.
sentences.zh: 他或他女儿有过接触的人，甚至仅仅是他们被发现时所在的公园长椅周边区域的人。

sentences.en: More surreal and extraordinary scenes in Salisbury this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 今天下午，索尔兹伯里出现了更多超现实且非同寻常的场景。

sentences.en: Wearing gas masks and protective clothing, military personnel loading potentially contaminated cars onto trucks.
sentences.zh: 军方人员戴着防毒面具和防护服，将可能受污染的汽车装上卡车。

sentences.en: Could this be construed as an act of chemical warfare?
sentences.zh: 这能被解读为一种化学战行为吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it basically is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上就是。

sentences.en: That's essentially what Theresa May, the prime minister of Britain, is saying.
sentences.zh: 这本质上就是英国首相特蕾莎·梅所表达的意思。

sentences.en: I mean, it was an act of war.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一场战争行为。

sentences.en: It was certainly a violent act committed on British territory, a violation of their sovereignty.
sentences.zh: 这无疑是在英国领土上实施的暴力行为，是对其主权的侵犯。

sentences.en: And she has taken it very, very seriously and treated it that way.
sentences.zh: 她对此非常、非常重视，并以此方式处理。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, this action has happened against a backdrop of a well-established pattern of Russian state aggression.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，这一行动是在俄罗斯国家一贯的侵略模式背景下发生的。

sentences.en: Theresa May got it before parliament.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎·梅在议会前提出了这一点。

sentences.en: She announced that she would expel
sentences.zh: 她宣布将驱逐

sentences.en: 23 Russian diplomats.
sentences.zh: 23名俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: This will be the single biggest expulsion for over 30 years.
sentences.zh: 这将是30多年来最大规模的一次驱逐行动。

sentences.en: And it reflects the fact that this is not the first time that the Russian state has acted against our country.
sentences.zh: 这反映出一个事实，即这并非俄罗斯国家首次针对我国采取行动。

sentences.en: Through these expulsions, we will fundamentally degrade Russian intelligence capability in the UK for years to come.
sentences.zh: 通过这些驱逐行动，我们将在未来几年从根本上削弱俄罗斯在英国的情报能力。

sentences.en: And if they seek to rebuild it, we will prevent them from doing so.
sentences.zh: 如果他们试图重建，我们将阻止他们这样做。

sentences.en: And she has organised basically the Western allies to follow suit in a coordinated way we have not seen in quite a while.
sentences.zh: 她基本上组织了西方盟友以一种我们许久未见的协调方式采取一致行动。

sentences.en: Dozens of Russian diplomats have been expelled from consulates and embassies around the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的领事馆和大使馆驱逐了数十名俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: Canada's expelling four diplomats.
sentences.zh: 加拿大驱逐了四名外交官。

sentences.en: Ukraine, 13, three in Albania and Norway.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰驱逐了13名，阿尔巴尼亚和挪威各驱逐了3名。

sentences.en: It's now 16 EU nations following suit.
sentences.zh: 目前已有16个欧盟国家效仿。

sentences.en: Germany, France, Poland.
sentences.zh: 德国、法国、波兰。

sentences.en: One by one, they joined Britain in a standoff with the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 他们一个接一个地加入英国，与克里姆林宫形成对峙。

sentences.en: The US retaliates its toughest action yet, expelling 60 Russian diplomats in response to the poisoning of an ex-Russian spy in Britain.
sentences.zh: 美国采取了迄今为止最强硬的报复行动，驱逐了60名俄罗斯外交官，以回应一名俄罗斯前间谍在英国中毒事件。

sentences.en: That's the largest expulsion of Russians from American soil going back decades and signaled a pretty striking change in posture by President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是几十年来美国本土驱逐俄罗斯人规模最大的一次，标志着特朗普总统的立场发生了相当显著的变化。

sentences.en: Although even to this moment, as far as we know, he has not yet publicly come out and made a personal condemnation in a visceral way, the way, say, Theresa May has.
sentences.zh: 尽管到目前为止，据我们所知，他还没有公开站出来，像特蕾莎·梅那样以一种发自肺腑的方式进行个人谴责。

sentences.en: Sad situation.
sentences.zh: 可悲的局面。

sentences.en: It certainly looks like the Russians were behind it.
sentences.zh: 这看起来确实像是俄罗斯人干的。

sentences.en: Something that should never, ever happen.
sentences.zh: 这是绝不应该发生的事情。

sentences.en: And we're taking it very seriously, as I think are many others.
sentences.zh: 我们非常重视这件事，我想许多其他人也是如此。

sentences.en: And Peter, were you surprised that the Trump administration joined Britain in doing this and expelling so many Russian diplomats?
sentences.zh: 彼得，特朗普政府加入英国行列，驱逐这么多俄罗斯外交官，你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: I would have been surprised if they didn't join Britain.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不加入英国，我才会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Britain, of course, is our closest ally.
sentences.zh: 英国当然是我们最亲密的盟友。

sentences.en: What does it mean to have a special relationship if you don't follow suit in this kind of thing?
sentences.zh: 如果不在这类事情上保持一致，所谓的“特殊关系”还有什么意义？

sentences.en: It would have been quite surprising if the United States did not follow the lead of Britain when Britain asked for this kind of action.
sentences.zh: 如果美国在英国要求采取此类行动时没有跟随英国的领导，那才真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: But having said that, given President Trump's notable desire not to alienate President Putin, given his
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，考虑到特朗普总统明显不想疏远普京总统，考虑到他

sentences.en: repeated efforts to not say anything that would be seen as critical of Russia, that sense is surprising.
sentences.zh: 一再努力避免说出任何会被视为批评俄罗斯的话，这种感觉确实令人惊讶。

sentences.en: And the number is surprising.
sentences.zh: 而且这个数字也令人惊讶。

sentences.en: 60 is a lot.
sentences.zh: 60人是个很大的数字。

sentences.en: He didn't have to necessarily do 60.
sentences.zh: 他其实不必非得驱逐60人。

sentences.en: He could have done a smaller amount and say he had done something.
sentences.zh: 他本可以驱逐较少的人数，然后说自己已经采取了行动。

sentences.en: And broadly speaking, who are the 60 people that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从广义上讲，美国驱逐的这60人

sentences.en: is expelling?
sentences.zh: 都是些什么人？

sentences.en: Well, 12 of them work at the United Nations, so they are categorized as diplomats.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中12人在联合国工作，所以他们被归类为外交官。

sentences.en: The other 48 work in the United States as diplomats, but at least a dozen of them, I think, are identified, at least by the United States, as being intelligence officers.
sentences.zh: 另外48人在美国担任外交官，但我认为其中至少有十几人被美国认定为情报官员。

sentences.en: That's pretty common.
sentences.zh: 这很常见。

sentences.en: Remember, Russia is a different system than ours.
sentences.zh: 记住，俄罗斯的体制与我们不同。

sentences.en: There's not really a whole big difference between civilian and intelligence work when it comes to their foreign service.
sentences.zh: 在他们的外交部门中，文职工作和情报工作之间并没有太大的区别。

sentences.en: There's a lot of overlap, a lot of, you know, murky lines.
sentences.zh: 有很多重叠，有很多，你知道，模糊的界限。

sentences.en: And so they may not have the official designation or be on the payroll of the intelligence agency, but they are obviously working in coordination.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能没有官方的指定身份，也不在情报机构的工资单上，但他们显然是在协同工作。

sentences.en: Why would we let Russians into this country as diplomats if we understand that there effectively is no line or virtually no line between diplomacy and spying in Russia?
sentences.zh: 如果我们明白俄罗斯的外交和间谍活动之间实际上没有界限，或者几乎没有界限，为什么我们还要让俄罗斯人以外交官身份进入这个国家呢？

sentences.en: Well, we do it because that's just the way it's always been done.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们这样做是因为一直以来都是这么做的。

sentences.en: And we expect other countries to accept the people we send over with diplomatic credentials, even though sometimes they're not really our diplomats.
sentences.zh: 我们期望其他国家接受我们派出的拥有外交证件的人员，尽管有时他们并不是真正的外交官。

sentences.en: You know, the CIA officers working in most countries are mostly accredited as diplomats.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在大多数国家工作的中央情报局官员大多是以外交官身份获得认证的。

sentences.en: So there's sort of a wink and a nod that goes among countries and has for many years on this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 所以各国之间多年来对这类事情有一种心照不宣的默契。

sentences.en: But when an episode like this comes up, it usually is a chance for a country to sort of clean house a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但当这样的事件发生时，这通常是一个国家清理门户的机会。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Sounds like it kind of goes both ways.
sentences.zh: 听起来这似乎是双向的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: But basically, if we well know that Russians in this country are likely up to some espionage, it sounds like these expulsions are simply kind of a political act.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，如果我们很清楚在这个国家的俄罗斯人可能在进行某种间谍活动，听起来这些驱逐行动仅仅是一种政治姿态。

sentences.en: They're largely symbolic rather than a meaningful national security move.
sentences.zh: 它们在很大程度上是象征性的，而非有意义的国家安全举措。

sentences.en: Well, look, you know, diplomacy is often about statements.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，你知道，外交往往关乎声明。

sentences.en: It's often about symbolism.
sentences.zh: 往往关乎象征意义。

sentences.en: It's often about drawing a line, even if it doesn't necessarily have a tangible impact.
sentences.zh: 往往关乎划定界限，即使它不一定产生实质性的影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's why we keep looking to President Trump and asking him why he's not saying things in a stronger way, because these things matter.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们一直盯着特朗普总统，问他为什么不以更强硬的方式表态，因为这些事情很重要。

sentences.en: They send signals.
sentences.zh: 它们会发出信号。

sentences.en: So to your point, what's the statement that President Trump or the Trump administration, since he's been a little more
sentences.zh: 那么回到你的观点，特朗普总统或特朗普政府——因为他一直比较

sentences.en: quiet, what's the statement that the Trump administration is making here with these expulsions?
sentences.zh: 安静——在这里通过这些驱逐行动发出了什么声明？

sentences.en: Well, the Trump administration is making the point that we, A, we stand with our ally and B,
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普政府表达的观点是：第一，我们与盟友站在一起；第二，

sentences.en: we're not going to tolerate without some sort of response, an attack on sovereignty like this.
sentences.zh: 我们不会容忍这种对主权的攻击而不做出某种回应。

sentences.en: But what we've often seen so far in the last 14 months is this duality of attitude toward Russia when it comes to the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 但我们在过去14个月里经常看到的是，特朗普政府对俄罗斯的态度存在这种双重性。

sentences.en: You've got, on the one hand, the administration itself, which sometimes takes actions like these or uses strong words of condemnation, sometimes expressed
sentences.zh: 一方面，政府本身有时会采取此类行动或使用强硬的谴责措辞，有时是由

sentences.en: by Rex Tillerson when he was Secretary of State or Nikki Haley as the UN ambassador or others.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森在担任国务卿时，或尼基·黑利作为联合国大使时，或其他官员表达的。

sentences.en: And then you've got the President of the United States himself, who almost never says anything that would seem to be in conflict with Russia.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，美国总统本人几乎从不发表任何看似与俄罗斯相冲突的言论。

sentences.en: Just last week, he called President Putin and congratulated him on an election that everybody else considered to be a sham, even though his own staff said, do not congratulate.
sentences.zh: 就在上周，他致电普京总统并祝贺他赢得了一场被其他人认为是一场闹剧的选举，尽管他自己的幕僚说“不要祝贺”。

sentences.en: And he didn't even mention the poisoning during this phone call.
sentences.zh: 而且他在通话中甚至没有提到中毒事件。

sentences.en: So there is this odd dichotomy between a president and the rest of his administration.
sentences.zh: 所以，总统与其政府其他部门之间存在这种奇怪的二分法。

sentences.en: Does it seem like only a matter of time until President Trump has to acknowledge
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着特朗普总统迟早不得不承认

sentences.en: that we are in this moment that you described as a kind of a hot piece?
sentences.zh: 我们正处于你所描述的那种“热战”时刻？

sentences.en: And this campaign idea of his, that we would be friends with Russia, that we would somehow find common ground and work out
sentences.zh: 而他那种竞选理念，即我们将与俄罗斯成为朋友，我们将以某种方式找到共同点，解决

sentences.en: our differences and manage some kind of a partnership is just not really possible.
sentences.zh: 我们的分歧并建立某种伙伴关系，这在现实中是不可能的。

sentences.en: It's not unusual for a new president to come in and say, hey, we're going to have a better relationship with Russia.
sentences.zh: 新总统上任时说“嘿，我们要和俄罗斯建立更好的关系”，这并不罕见。

sentences.en: It matters to us to have a better relationship with Russia.
sentences.zh: 与俄罗斯建立更好的关系对我们很重要。

sentences.en: President Clinton came in and said that.
sentences.zh: 克林顿总统上任时这么说过。

sentences.en: President Bush came in and said that.
sentences.zh: 布什总统上任时这么说过。

sentences.en: President Obama came in and said that.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统上任时这么说过。

sentences.en: What's different about President Trump is he seems immune to the sort of pressure points that other presidents responded to, which is to say that even though they wanted
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的不同之处在于，他似乎对其他总统所回应的那种压力点免疫，也就是说，尽管他们想要

sentences.en: good relations, when the Russians didn't respond in a way that was constructive or friendly, they said so.
sentences.zh: 良好的关系，但当俄罗斯人的回应方式不具建设性或不友好时，他们会指出来。

sentences.en: They called them out on it.
sentences.zh: 他们会公开批评。

sentences.en: And President Trump seems very, very determined not to do that.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普总统似乎非常、非常坚定地不这样做。

sentences.en: And his argument would be, it's good for us to have a good relationship and therefore it's good that I maintain friendship with Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 他的论点是，与俄罗斯保持良好关系对我们有利，因此我与弗拉基米尔·普京保持友谊是件好事。

sentences.en: But it seems so in conflict with the events as they have been playing out over the last year that people are automatically and not surprisingly suspicious of what it might mean.

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: I mean, that does seem like the inevitable question.

sentences.en: How, if at all, does this connect to the
sentences.zh: 这与“通俄门”调查有何关联（如果有的话）？

sentences.en: Russia investigation?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯调查？

sentences.en: One thought I had, one thing I was kind of wondering about as we've been talking here is whether President Trump's action, these expulsions, is about the poisoning of a

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin.

sentences.zh: 你本以为到了现在，任何其他被问及此事的政治家都会说些什么来消除这种印象。

sentences.en: And he seems to, in fact, dig in the opposite way.
sentences.zh: 而他似乎反而向相反的方向深陷。

sentences.en: He seems more determined to not publicly condemn Vladimir Putin, even though everybody's telling him he ought to, maybe because everybody is telling him he ought to.
sentences.zh: 他似乎更坚定地不公开谴责弗拉基米尔·普京，尽管每个人都告诉他应该这样做，也许正是因为每个人都告诉他应该这样做。

sentences.en: But the administration itself, below him, he has allowed or permitted or authorized or even ordered them

sentences.zh: 采取其他政府也可能采取的行动，即美国政府在

sentences.zh: 民主党或共和党执政下。

sentences.zh: 这种政策的双重性很不寻常，也非常难以解释。

sentences.en: And that, again, is why this Russia investigation matters, because people are trying to see, does the one follow the other?
sentences.zh: 而这再次说明了为什么这项俄罗斯调查很重要，因为人们试图观察，前者是否导致了后者？
